slides.title: Cover — Crelix AI
slides.task_brief:
Cover slide for Crelix AI pitch deck. Dark background (#0a0a0f) with a large spectrum gradient glow behind the title.

Content:
- Top-left: brand mark 'crelix' with gradient square logo
- Center-left aligned:
  - Small pill: 'Crelix AI — AI Platform' with a pulsing lime dot
  - Massive headline (56px, 800 weight): 'Launch your site.' on line 1, 'Scan before go-live.' on line 2 with spectrum gradient text (lime→cyan→blue→purple)
  - Subtitle (18px, muted): 'The AI platform that turns a prompt into a deployed launch page — then runs an authorized pre-launch security scan.'
  - Bottom row: 'CRELIX INNOVATIONS LLP' in mono + 'crelixai.com' in mono, separated by a dot
- Bottom-right: slide number '01 / 16'
- Visual: large radial spectrum glow (200px blur) positioned top-right corner, lime/cyan/blue/purple gradient at 15% opacity

Speaker notes: Welcome to Crelix AI. We're an AI platform built by CRELIX INNOVATIONS LLP that helps founders launch their sites and scan them for security issues before going live. Today I'll walk you through our three suites — Flow, Pentest, and Search — our architecture, traction, and how we're building the execution layer for AI-powered product launches.

slides.title: The Problem
slides.task_brief:
Problem slide showing 3 pain points founders face when launching.

Content:
- Brand mark top-left, slide number '02 / 16' bottom-right
- Top: pill 'The Problem'
- Headline (40px): 'Launching is slow. Security is an afterthought.'
- 3 cards in a row, each with an icon, title, and description:
  1. Icon: 'schedule' (red/orange tint). Title: 'Slow Development'. Text: 'Building a launch page takes days to weeks. Founders waste time on setup, design, copy, and deployment instead of talking to users.'
  2. Icon: 'security' (red tint). Title: 'Security Blind Spots'. Text: 'Most launch pages go live without a security scan. Vulnerabilities are discovered after traffic arrives — too late to prevent damage.'
  3. Icon: 'extension' (orange tint). Title: 'Fragmented Tools'. Text: 'Founders juggle 4-5 tools: design, copy, code, deploy, security. Each has its own learning curve, cost, and integration headaches.'

Speaker notes: The problem is clear. Founders today face three major challenges when launching. First, development is slow — building a launch page takes days or weeks, time that should go to user conversations. Second, security is always an afterthought — most pages go live without any scan, and vulnerabilities are found too late. Third, the toolchain is fragmented — founders juggle four or five separate tools for design, copy, code, deploy, and security. Each adds cost, learning curve, and integration headaches. Crelix AI solves all three.

  - Headline (40px): 'One platform. Prompt to live. Scan before go-live.'
  - Body (16px, muted): 'Crelix AI is the AI platform that turns a prompt into a deployed launch page — then runs an authorized pre-launch security scan so you ship with confidence. No coding, no DevOps, no waitlist.'
  - 3 key points with colored dots:
    - Lime dot: 'Prompt-based generation — describe what you need, get a live URL'
    - Cyan dot: 'Pre-launch security scan — 12 specialist agents, 11 vulnerability classes'
    - Blue dot: 'One workflow — no tool-switching, no context loss'
- Right column (40%): A card showing a mock terminal/prompt interface:
  - Dark card with border
  - Top: mono label 'crelix — flow'
  - Body: faux prompt text 'Build a launch page for an AI note-taking app...'

Speaker notes: Crelix AI is one platform that solves the entire launch problem. You describe your project in a prompt, and our agent team generates the design, copy, code, and deploys it live. Then, without leaving the workflow, you run a pre-launch security scan with 12 specialist agents covering 11 vulnerability classes. No coding, no DevOps, no waitlist. It's not another AI wrapper — it's the execution layer that orchestrates specialized agents as one coordinated team.

Speaker notes: Flow is our first suite. You describe what you want — a launch page, a SaaS app, a dashboard — and the agent team takes over. The Planner creates the spec, the Designer handles layout and copy, the Engineer generates frontend and backend code, and the Deployer publishes a live URL. The whole process takes about 47 seconds for a launch page. You can iterate with natural language, bring your own domain, and redeploy with one click. No coding required.

slides.title: Crelix AI Pentest
slides.task_brief:
Product slide for Crelix AI Pentest suite. Lime accent color.

Content:
- Brand mark top-left, slide number '05 / 16' bottom-right
- Top: pill with lime dot 'Suite 02 — Pentest'
- Headline (36px): 'Pre-launch security scan with evidence'
- Left column (55%):
  - Description: 'Run a structured pre-launch security scan on a target you own. Pentest reports findings with evidence, severity, and guidance.'
  - 4 feature rows with lime 'shield' icons:
    - '12 specialist agents · 11 vulnerability classes'
    - 'OWASP Top 10 + business logic + race conditions'
    - 'Evidence-backed findings with severity levels'
    - 'Authorized targets only — SOC 2 / GDPR aligned'
  - 4 compliance pills: 'OWASP', 'SOC 2', 'GDPR', 'API Security'
- Right column (45%): A scan demo card:
  - 'crelix — pentest' mono label with pulsing lime dot + 'scanning' status
  - 5 vulnerability class rows with check/warning icons:
    - 'Broken Access Control — 1 high finding' (warning icon, red)
    - 'Injection — clean' (check icon, lime)
    - 'Auth Failures — 2 medium findings' (warning icon, orange)
    - 'SSRF — clean' (check icon, lime)
    - 'Crypto Failures — clean' (check icon, lime)
  - Bottom: 'Scan complete — 3 findings · 12s' in lime

Speaker notes: Pentest is our second suite. Before you announce your launch, you run a pre-launch security scan. We spawn 12 specialist agents — one per vulnerability class — in parallel. They cover the OWASP Top 10 plus business logic errors, race conditions, and SSRF. Every finding comes with request/response evidence, severity rating, and remediation guidance. It's authorized targets only, and aligned with SOC 2 and GDPR controls. This is not a replacement for a full audit, but it catches the obvious issues before you drive traffic.

slides.title: Architecture
slides.task_brief:
Architecture slide showing the 3-layer stack.

Content:
- Brand mark top-left, slide number '08 / 16' bottom-right
- Pill: 'The Architecture'
- Headline (40px): 'Crelix AI is not a model'
- Subtitle (16px, muted): 'An execution layer that turns AI intelligence into structured workflows, deployed systems, and real business outcomes.'
- 3 horizontal layer bars stacked vertically (centered, max-width 700px):
  1. Top layer (white bg, dark text): 'Running Systems' — 'Deployed pages, apps, and scans' + spinning loader icon on right
  2. Middle layer (glass bg, spectrum border): 'Crelix Execution Layer' — 'Orchestration • workflows • agents' + gradient circle logo on left. Slightly wider/elevated.
  3. Bottom layer (lime bg, dark text): 'AI models' — 'Leading frontier models' + OpenAI/Anthropic/Google text logos
- Between layers: small dash-line connectors (animated-looking dashed lines)
- Right side (below the stack): 3 pillar points:
  - 'Orchestrated, not chat' — agents coordinate as one team
  - 'Structured workflows' — evidence, not prose
  - 'Real business outcomes' — live URL, not a demo

Speaker notes: Crelix AI is not a model. We don't train our own LLM. Instead, we're an execution layer that sits between frontier AI models and running systems. At the bottom, we orchestrate the best models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. In the middle, the Crelix Execution Layer coordinates specialized agents — planner, designer, engineer, tester, deployer, security — as one team. At the top, running systems: deployed pages, apps, and scans that you can actually use. This is what sets us apart. We're not another chatbot wrapper. We're the infrastructure that turns AI intelligence into real business outcomes.
